scope: Read the official PBS schedule archive landing page and linked year-page HTML metadata (2003-2026); followed no schedule XML, API CSV, ZIP, or PDF data links. A follow-on metadata review consulted official schema-history documentation and the API information page only. No schedule source payload bytes were requested or read.
interpretation: The official archive page links yearly schedule pages for 2003-2026. This observation lists schedule-data links labeled XML or PBS API CSV on those pages. XML labels without V2/V3 remain version-unspecified; a V2 down-converted link is a distinct distribution representation, not proof of an original source era. The API CSV links appear in schedule page metadata from 2025-05 onward; the XML link labels extend through 2026-05 in this capture. The pages do not prove the complete approved source denominator, source byte identity, reuse rights, field semantics, or Silver eligibility. Absence of an XML/API CSV link from these pages is not evidence no source existed elsewhere.
